request.prompt: Transfer ONLY the continuous professional blackjack dealing movements of the seated female dealer in the main video panel of the driving screen recording to Astrid, the blonde woman in the reference image. Use the image as the complete output scene and identity: exactly Astrid's face, hair, skin colour, white blouse, black suit, fixed front camera, lighting, table and shoe. The driving video is a screen recording: ignore all browser/YouTube interfaces, text, thumbnails and the standing background man. Reproduce the seated woman's precise efficient hand rhythm at original speed: take one card at the shoe, carry and slide it to successive player spots across the table, immediately return the empty hand to the shoe and deal the next card; no folded arms or idle reset between cards. Maintain natural anatomy and stable face and skin exposure. Both hands and every fingertip stay visible. Single uninterrupted fixed-camera photographic shot, no zooms or cuts. No interface, captions, numbers or text overlays.
